PowerShell($sql = Get-Content "src\\main\\resources\\import.sql" -Raw; $refs = [regex]::Matches\($sql, "/\(CopertinaManga|sfondoManga\)/\([^']+\)"\) | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[0].Value }; $missing = @\(\); foreach \($r in $refs\) { $p = "src\\main\\resources\\static" + \($r -replace '/', '\\'\); if \(-not \(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p\)\) { $missing += $r } }; if \($missing.Count -eq 0\) { "Tutte le $\($refs.Count\) immagini referenziate esistono" } else { "MANCANTI:"; $missing })

PowerShell($deadline = \(Get-Date\).AddSeconds\(60\); $up = $false; while \(\(Get-Date\) -lt $deadline\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:8080/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; if \($r.StatusCode -eq 200\) { $up = $true; break } } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if \($up\) { "App avviata: / risponde 200" } else { "App NON risponde entro 60s" })

PowerShell($log = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\siwmanga_boot.log" -Raw; $errs = \($log -split "`n"\) | Where-Object { $_ -match "ERROR|Exception|LazyInitialization" } | Select-Object -First 10; if \($errs\) { "ERRORI TROVATI:"; $errs } else { "Nessun ERROR / Exception nei log" }; ""; "--- Ultime Session Metrics ---"; \(\($log -split "`n"\) | Where-Object { $_ -match "statements|Session Metrics|JDBC" } | Select-Object -Last 12\) -join "`n")
